title: Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize
abstract: arXiv:2610.01590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-spec

translated_title: 通往中间层的两条路径：位置搜索与大脑读出在持续学习器应特化的位置上达成共识
translated_abstract: 持续学习器若在预训练视觉Transformer的每个块中都保留任务特定适配器，其存储量将随任务数量线性增长；而仅在少数块中保留任务特定适配器可以抑制这种增长，但引出了应将适配器放置在何处的问题。我们从两个视角研究这一问题。在算法层面，训练所有连续的四块放置方案呈现出倒U型规律：最终准确率在中间深度处达到峰值，不同位置间的变化幅度高达3.5个百分点；而基于权重谱或激活统计的廉价选择标准则倾向于最深的块。从神经科学角度看，视觉皮层的层级组织及其中间阶段的可塑性促使我们思考：能否利用学习器外部的测量手段来指导层的特化，从而无需进行位置搜索。LS-B通过冻结的、涵盖十二个人类视觉脑区的fMRI编码模型来观察最初的任务，并据此提交任务……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究通过算法位置搜索与基于人类视觉皮层fMRI编码模型的神经科学读出这两条独立路径，共同发现持续学习中的任务特定适配器应放置在预训练视觉Transformer的中间层。
en_tdlr: Through both algorithmic placement search and neuroscience-based brain readouts using a frozen fMRI encoding model of human visual cortex, this study finds converging evidence that task-specific adapters in continual learning should be placed in the intermediate layers of pre-trained vision transformers.
